summary: Integrated Media Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing a change to its Annual General Meeting date: the previously scheduled AGM on May 29, 2026, has been cancelled, and a new AGM will convene on June 9, 2026. The filing includes a notice of meeting, revised proxy form, and explanatory memorandum covering ordinary business such as financial statements. No special-situation event like an acquisition, divestiture, or management change is present. This is a routine scheduling update, equivalent to a U.S. issuer postponing its annual meeting. There are no deal terms or strategic actions to analyze.
